description:
Webcam capture (sarxos webcam-capture) and OpenCV (bytedeco, with OpenBLAS and
		JavaCPP). The natives of the build machine come from the OS-activated profiles below;
		-Djavacpp.platform=<platform> (a system property - profile activation does not see
		the properties of the consuming POM) selects another platform instead. Natives of the
		other platforms for per-platform packaging: copy the classifier variants of the
		org.bytedeco dependencies (maven-dependency-plugin copy-dependencies with classifier).
